name: omnical/caldav
description: Omnical's CalDAV (RFC 4791), under any PHP host: the calendars of iCloud, Fastmail, Nextcloud or any sabre/dav server found from the server's address (current-user-principal, calendar-home-set), their events read (recurrences expanded or kept as RRULE data, time zones, attendees) and written (PUT with If-None-Match and If-Match against lost updates, DELETE), and busy time (free-busy-query, or computed from the events where the server does not answer it) - on sabre/xml and sabre/vobject, credentials by reference.
